exposure: maternal nutritional status (normal weight, overweight, obese)
outcome: profiles of amino acids (leucine, lysine, tyrosine, aspartic acid)
sugars and derivatives (fucose, rhamnose, gluconic acid)
metabolic pathways in mature human milk
cohort: Human milk samples were collected from 109 women categorized as normal weight (n=60), overweight (n=35), and obese (n=14).
finding: Maternal obesity significantly increases the proportion of certain amino acids, energetic molecules, and sugars in human milk, while maternal age and infant sex also influence specific metabolite levels.
cross-section timing: Mature human milk samples were analyzed, exact timing postpartum not specified.
